text: Good evening. I have been trying to reach someone on this line for almost one hour now and nobody is picking, so I am just going to type everything here and please somebody should reply me. My sister is 5 months old. My mummy is at work and I am the one watching her tonight. She is having temperature, the thermometer is showing 37.8. Before, she was just a bit warm and I did not worry too much. But when I was changing her nappy now now I saw some small reddish purple spots on her legs and on her belly. At first I thought maybe it is heat rash or she scratched herself, abi. I remembered my aunty saying something about pressing glass on rashes, so I took a clear cup and pressed it on the spots, and I think they did not fade at all, they were still showing through the glass. I am not sure if I did it correctly sha, maybe I did not press hard enough. I have called my mummy two times and her phone is not going. Please I just want to know what I should do because I am not a doctor and I don't want to be the one that did not do something.
